mapper.select: SELECT r.*, m.menu_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_code FROM sys_role r LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON r.role_id = rm.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_menu m ON rm.menu_id = m.menu_id AND m.is_deleted = 0 WHERE r.role_id = #{roleId} AND r.is_deleted = 0

SELECT * FROM sys_role WHERE is_deleted = 0
AND role_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{roleName}, '%')
AND role_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{roleCode}, '%')
AND status = #{status}
ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_role SET role_name = #{roleName}, role_code = #{roleCode}, system_name = #{systemName}, remark = #{remark}, status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE role_id = #{roleId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE sys_role SET is_deleted = 1, deleted_at = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
